name: Transaction Operation Type 10 Code
definition: Specifies the transaction operation action type.

CORR.name: Correction
CORR.definition: Transaction corrects errors in a previously sent transaction.

EROR.name: Error
EROR.definition: Cancellation of a wrongly submitted entire report in case the contract never came into existence or was not subject to regulatory reporting requirements but was reported to a regulatory authority by mistake or a cancellation of duplicate report.

MODI.name: Modification
MODI.definition: Transaction modifies in a previously sent transaction.

POSC.name: Position Component
POSC.definition: Contract to be reported as a new trade and included in a separate position report on the same day.

REVI.name: Revive
REVI.definition: Re-opening of a derivative, at a trade or position level, that was cancelled or terminated by mistake.

TERM.name: Termination
TERM.definition: Closing of an existing transaction because of a new event (for example: Compression, Novation). This does not apply to transactions that terminate at contractual maturity date.

VALU.name: Valuation Update
VALU.definition: Update of a contract valuation or collateral.

MARU.name: Margin Update
MARU.definition: Indicates the report of the collateral data or of their modifications, but not the corrections of the previously reported collateral details.

PRTO.name: Port Out
PRTO.definition: Indicates transfers swap transaction from one SDR to another SDR (change of swap data repository).
